scripts.build:domain: pnpm --filter @minions/core exec tsc -b --force && pnpm --filter @minions/testkit exec tsc -b --force
scripts.build:integration: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @minions/core exec tsc -b --force && pnpm --filter @minions/adapters exec tsc -b --force && pnpm --filter @minions/testkit exec tsc -b --force
scripts.test:unit: pnpm build:domain && vitest run apps packages test/unit --passWithNoTests
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.json && pnpm -r exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false -p tsconfig.json
scripts.verify:pr: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm deadcode && pnpm generate:check && pnpm proto:lint && pnpm proto:breaking && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm test:integration
